title: Root reads /etc/shadow with cat
threat_model: No attacker. An administrator reads /etc/shadow as root with cat, for example to check an account.
notes: The action runs cat /etc/shadow with the output sent to /dev/null, as S14 does. Nothing is created, so there is no teardown. Predicted: sensitive_file_access (T1003.008), tier 1, alerts, because cat is not in EXPECTED_READERS. The marker reaches the alert through the ancestry.
